purpose: Verified contract for evaluating whether documented property events explain observed state changes.
causation_rule: Temporal sequence alone is insufficient; causation requires an evidence link and applicable legal mechanism.
registration_rule: Where registration is material to legal effect, registration evidence is evaluated separately.
multi_event_rule: Multiple events may contribute to one observed change and must not be collapsed into a single cause without support.
alternative_rule: Material alternative causal events remain visible until resolved.
historical_rule: Historical causation uses the law and evidence applicable to the relevant period.
verification_boundary: The resolver assesses supported causal links; it does not create missing evidence.
